The screen has a uniform yellow wash without any pixel structure, reflection, or glass-like specular highlights, making it look like a flat painted rectangle rather than a glass display.
The perspective lines of the device are slightly inconsistent; the left and right edges do not converge perfectly towards a single vanishing point, giving the device a slightly warped appearance.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the keypad. In AI-generated images of older tech, keypads often melt into a single blob. Verify if the buttons are distinct entities.
